name: Entity Builder
description: Spreadsheet-driven entity architecture management for Drupal. Design, preview, and deploy entity architectures using YAML.
project_description:
Entity Builder is a declarative entity architecture management tool for Drupal 11 (this documented release is 1.0.0-alpha1, a pre-release). Design, preview, and deploy content types, fields, displays, field groups, and menus using a flat, spreadsheet-friendly YAML format. Entity Builder handles dependency resolution automatically, so you never need to worry about operation ordering.

How it works: Entity Builder uses a definition-centric workflow. You create definitions (via UI or YAML), preview the changes, then apply them to your site. Definitions are reusable config entities that can be applied multiple times with smart sync - new items are created, changed items are updated, and unchanged items are skipped. Under the hood, Entity Builder converts your definitions into atomic operations (create bundle, create field, configure display, etc.) and automatically resolves dependencies.

Features: flat YAML format (one row per item), automatic dependency resolution, idempotent smart-sync imports, two-stage validation (operation-specific plus cross-cutting validator plugins), full rollback support, session- and operation-level audit logging, runtime discovery of field types/widgets/formatters, a complete Drush CLI, and an extensible plugin system (operations, validators, extensions).

Supported operations (12 built in): create/update/delete bundles; create/update/delete/hide/reorder fields; configure form-mode and view-mode displays; create menus and menu links. Field groups, Pathauto patterns, and Auto Entity Label are supported through separate extension modules.

The processing engine and YAML import live in the base module. The included eb_ui sub-module adds a browser-based YAML editor and shared AJAX API endpoints; the separately released Entity Builder AG-Grid module adds a full spreadsheet experience.
